description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [Attach Lightning 3 with Stacking], [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Tower Sentinel Mode] and [Frenzied Thunder Mode] to the user

description.name: Attach Lightning 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Lightning Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Lightning 3

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands

description.name: Tower Sentinel Mode
description.text: Grants [Lightning Ability +10% Boost 1]/[Lightning Ability +20% Boost 1]/[Lightning Ability +30% Boost 1] to all allies and increases Tower Sentinel level by 1 at Tower Sentinel level 0/1/2 after using Selfless Call, removed after triggering three times, removed if the character hasn't [Synchro Mode]

description.name: Frenzied Thunder Mode
description.text: Grants [Dualcast Lightning 1]/[Triplecast Lightning 1]/[Quadracast Lightning 1] after using Selfless Call if the user has Enduring Flash level 1/2/3, removed after using a Lightning ability
